sources.title: hari12-hp/enzyme-tfidf-logreg · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The training script always reads ../train.parquet relative to its own location, regardless of your current shell folder. It builds an exact-reaction-grouped 80/20 local holdout (seed 42), prints the contest's fractional-credit L1–L4 top-1 accuracy, then retrains on alltrain.parquet and saves weights/tfidf_logreg.joblib.
